content: Jesus Neegwiindaii
Neegwaazhii Drin ąįįtł'ęę Drinzhit vanh shree khahee'aa gwehkįį, Mary Magdalene ts'ą' ch'izhii Mary, haa tth'ank'it gwagwahąąh'yaa geenjit gwats'ą' gahaa'oo.
Khan hee nankat gwint'aii gwaatrat nagwaanąįį, gwiizhit zheekat gwats'an K'eegwaadhat vizheekat gwich'in zhat nadaanaii ts'ą' kii choh gwadąįį dha'aii gihłeehiłdzik ts'ą' yakat doondii.
Nahtan needoohaadhak k'it viyiichy'a' ts'ą' vagwach'aa chan zhah k'it daagąįį.
Niveet'ah'in zhat gwak'ąąhtii nąįį it'ee shrit gihilghaa ts'ąįį gwint'aii gaatrat ts'ą' oozhak t'eegiiheełnaii ts'ą' giłchįį k'it t'igiinchy'aa nagaanaii.
Gaa zheekat gwich'in ąįį zhit tr'injaa nąįį t'ahnyąą, “Noojat kwaa, Jesus giriłtsak chy'ah vankeegǫǫh'in nakhwaashandaii.
Dzaa dhidii kwaa, gwandaii neeheelyaa nyąą chy'aa gwik'it t'iizhit t'inchy'aa, aanaii dzaa vich'ichį' nijin t'inchy'aa, chy'aa gooh'in.

Khants'ą' oo'an neekhwajyaa ts'ą' vitsyaa nąįį haa goondak. ‘Ch'ichį' ts'an needhikhin ąįįts'ą' juk zhat Galilee nahkat nakhwehkii gwats'ą' haazhii ts'ą', ąįį zhit ji' hǫǫh'yaa t'inchy'aa.’ Deenakhwaihnyą' gineehoondaii yuu.”
Ąįįts'ą' tth'ank'it gwats'an gąąnjat gaa goozhit shoo dha'aii haa oo'an vitsyaa nąįį haa gwagwaandak geenjit gihłeegalgihiljil.
Khan hee Jesus goots'ą' tr'iinzhii ts'ą' t'agavahnyąą, “Tsinehdan nakhwaa oolį'!” Giits'ą' haajil ts'ą' zhat giikwai' oonjik ts'ą' giits'ą' nikiigwiintthaii.
“Noojat shrǫ', shitsyaa nąįį, shachaa k'it t'igiinchy'aa Galilee nahkat gwats'ą' hohjyaa goovohnyąą ts'ą' ąįį zhit ji' goohaał'yaa.” gavahnyąą.
Niveet'ah'in Nąįį Tth'ank'it Gwik'eegaahti' Geenjit Deeginyą'
Tr'injaa nąįį k'ii'an gihłeegahoojil gwiizhit niveet'ah'in tth'ank'it gwik'eegąąhtii lat nąįį, giinkhih kįh dilk'ii nąįį ts'eegahoojil ts'ą' deegwiizhik datthak gavaa gwagwaandak.
Giinkhih kįh dilk'ii nąįį ts'ą' Jews kįh dilk'ii nąįį haa nihłaa khaihłan nigiinjil ts'ą' deegihee'yaa geegiginkhe' ts'ą' laraa lęįį gavantł'eegiinlii,
ts'ą' t'agoogahnyąą, “Zhat tǫǫ tr'iłchųų gwiizhik vitsyaa nąįį zhat gwats'ą' gahaajil ts'ą' giichį' naa'įį łee hohjyaa yuu.” googahnyąą.
Ąįįts'ą' Governor Pilate gwiitth'ak ji', nakhwan'ąįį gwiizųų t'akhwazhit kwaa varahaanjyaa ts'ą' diik'injiheeghit tr'ahahtsyaa t'inchy'aa, ąįįts'ą' geenjit tr'agohdii gwat'oohchy'aa kwaa googahnyąą.”
Niveet'ah'in nąįį laraa lęįį tee gwigwįłjik ts'ą' deegooreiinyą' chy'aa gwik'it t'igiinyą'. Ts'ą' juk gweendaa googaa nihk'it jyaa diginyąą haa Jews nąįį datthak nihłehjuk geegigiinkhii goodlit.
Jesus, Ditsyaa Nąįį Ts'ą' Vigweelkįį
Jesus, vitsyaa, 11 nąįį, Galilee nahkat gwizhit taih dha'aii ąįį zhit gwats'ą' hohjyaa gavahnyąą ąįį gwik'it t'igiizhik.
Goolat nąįį giik'injiighit kwaa gaa nijin giiyąąh'ya' dąį' giits'ą' khadigeedi'.
Jesus goots'ą' nahgǫǫ niinzhii ts'ą' t'agavahnyąą. “Zheekat ts'ą' nankat haa datthak geenjit t'aih shintł'eetr'iin'ąįį t'oonchy'aa!
Ąįįts'ą' nankat gwich'in nąįį datthak goots'ą' hohjyaa ts'ą' shitsyaa gavohtsii. Gwiti', Gwidinji' ts'ą' Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą oozhri' zhit chųų goots'an ohtsii,
ts'ą' shik'eegwagwahahthat geenjit geegavǫhtan ts'ą' deenakhwaihnyą' datthak geenjit chan gavaa goondak. Ts'ą' nan ndaagwąąn'ąį' gwats'ą' datthak, nakhwaa hihłyaa t'oonchy'aa.” Jesus gavahnyąą.
